content.text: {"answer":"Tobias Rendle","citations":["D085","D054","D087","D006"],"explanation":"A private May 19, 2025 note establishes that Tobias Rendle owned Tansleigh \"as of today,\" with the announcement deferred pending ramp approval. The July 2025 onsite note corroborates new management, and no source records a later change before September 1, 2025. Hollis Mbeki only held the account from January 6, 2025, so he was the prior owner."}
